D/ IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG ; R/ SOLI INVI-CTO COMITI

A Roman copper-alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337), dated to AD 307-318. Mint of London. Mint mark: S/F//MSL. RIC VII (London) p. 99, no. 32. Obverse inscription: IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG. Obverse description: Right-facing laureate and cuirassed bust. Reverse inscription: SOLI INVI-CTO COMITI. Reverse description: Sol standing left, holding globe and raising hand. Diameter: 20.58 mm;…
